benefits_health_001.evidence: The Board will annually provide a fully paid individual major medical plan to all full-time teachers.

benefits_health_contribution_002.answer: Fully paid for full-time teachers; half-paid for part-time (filling half or more but less than full-time) teachers
benefits_health_contribution_002.evidence: The Board will annually provide a fully paid individual major medical plan to all full-time teachers. ... Teachers, who fill half or more but less than full-time positions, shall annually receive Board half-paid health insurance.

benefits_dependent_health_004.evidence: Dependent coverage shall be available at the expense of the teacher.

benefits_health_plan_type_005.evidence: Specific benefits shall be as delineated in “The School District of Osceola County Florida Medical Indemnity Plan Document”

benefits_dental_006.evidence: The Board will make available to teachers, disability benefits, an indemnity dental insurance plan and vision insurance plan through payroll deduction at the teacher's expense
